subject.title: Add configurable descriptive agent session labels

question: Should CodexBar expose three persistent Agent sessions label modes backed by Codex local thread metadata?
rationale: The patch is an optional user-facing configuration addition rather than a repair to an established behavior, so long-term settings and UX scope need maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the configurable labels
options.body: Keep the project default and proceed once the PR provides runtime proof and is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Keep project-only labels
options.body: Decline the additional preference surface and retain the existing stable project-name presentation.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Accept descriptive labels only if maintainers prefer a smaller fixed presentation policy rather than three selectable modes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the configurable labels
recommendation.body: Keep the project default and proceed once the PR provides runtime proof and is refreshed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available decision owner for a new persistent settings and menu-label product direction.
